entries.text: Pitch-black night. A supercharged airboat tears through a flooded cypress swamp at impossible speed, desperately escaping through an ever-changing maze of narrow black-water channels. The engine screams, the giant rear propeller blasts hurricane-force spray, and the swamp feels alive, trying to destroy the boat. The camera never stops moving: aerial dives through the trees, ultra-low water-level chase shots, aggressive FPV beside the spinning propeller, overhead drone reveals, violent orbit shots, crash zooms, whip pans, and near-miss flybys inches from the hull. Every second raises the stakes. The driver drifts through impossibly tight gaps between ancient cypress trunks, narrowly misses submerged logs and hidden roots, blasts through dense reeds, jumps over floating debris, skims muddy banks, and threads collapsing wooden bridges while massive beams, splinters, and chains crash all around. The boat launches off natural wakes, lands hard already sideways, ricochets through impossible S-turns, and squeezes through gaps with only inches to spare as branches whip across the camera and walls of black water explode into the air. The final seconds become absolute chaos: towering fallen trees block the channel, the driver commits to impossible last-second maneuvers at full throttle, the airboat launches beneath collapsing structures while debris rains from above, then bursts into open water as a gigantic rooster tail erupts behind and the collapsing swamp seems to swallow the escape route. Style: IMAX-quality hyper-realism, relentless speed, escalating danger, physically accurate water physics, cinematic lighting, volumetric fog, crystal-clear action, dramatic camera movement, no slow motion, no text, no logos, no recognizable faces.

entries.title: OscarAI · More war scenes created with Seedance 2.5. I'm sharing the prompt in the post below 👇
entries.text:
More war scenes created with Seedance 2.5.

I'm sharing the prompt in the post below 👇

30-second cinematic aerial action spectacle, breathtaking high-budget feature film, ultra-dynamic editing, fluid aerial choreography, premium cinematic visuals, seamless kinetic camera movement, aggressive speed ramps, rapid match cuts, whip pans, rotating camera moves, dramatic perspective shifts, cinematic lens distortion, volumetric storm clouds, ocean spray, glowing tracer lights, smoke trails, sparks, flying debris, colossal scale, emotionally epic, no dialogue.

0–5s
Dark storm clouds gather above a vast open ocean.
A colossal armored battleship cuts through enormous waves.
Far above, a lone high-performance fighter aircraft emerges from the clouds.
Extreme close-ups.
Pilot visor.
Hands on the controls.
Jet intake vibrating.
Radar display glowing.
The camera alternates between immense aerial vistas and intimate cockpit shots.
Complete silence.

5–10s
The fighter rolls onto its wing and dives toward the ocean.
The camera races only meters from the aircraft before instantly switching to first-person cockpit views, impossible wing-mounted perspectives, sweeping aerial fly-bys and dramatic low-angle shots skimming above the waves.
The ship rapidly grows larger.
The engines reach full power.

10–15s
A breathtaking aerial montage.
The fighter slices between towering smoke columns and dense clouds.
Bright streams of tracer light streak across the sky.
The aircraft performs impossible barrel rolls, high-G turns and vertical climbs while the camera continuously rotates around the fuselage.
Speed ramps amplify every maneuver.

15–20s
The fighter skims just above the ocean surface.
Towering walls of spray rise behind it.
It climbs sharply over the battleship's deck in one uninterrupted shot.
The camera dives beneath the aircraft, then whips upward through drifting smoke, sparks and sunlight breaking through the storm.
Everything feels impossibly fast.

20–25s
The sequence reaches maximum intensity.
The aircraft circles the massive vessel at incredible speed.
Towering water plumes erupt around the ship.
Clouds swirl overhead.
The camera jumps between ultra-wide aerial compositions, intimate cockpit close-ups, spinning chase shots, dramatic slow-motion fly-bys and impossible orbiting movements around both aircraft and ship.
Every cut increases the spectacle.

25–30s
Everything suddenly slows.
The fighter climbs vertically through the storm clouds into brilliant sunlight.
Far below, the gigantic battleship disappears beneath drifting mist and shimmering ocean reflections.
The camera pulls rapidly upward into an immense aerial shot revealing endless sky and sea stretching to the horizon.

Hard cut to black.

Sound design: soaring cinematic orchestra, thunderous percussion, deep brass, roaring jet engines, rushing wind, ocean waves crashing against steel, atmospheric echoes, powerful fly-by whooshes, subtle sonic booms, cinematic bass swells, brief silence before the final climb, overwhelming orchestral finale.

entries.title: Pierrick Chevallier | IA · This is exactly the kind of shot where Seedance 2.5 shines. 🏎️💨 Speed, precision, aggressive c
entries.text:
This is exactly the kind of shot where Seedance 2.5 shines. 🏎️💨
Speed, precision, aggressive camera work… and just enough chaos to make you think it’s all about to go VERY wrong. 💀

Turn the sound up for this one.
PROMPT 👇
Ultra-realistic high-speed rally action with premium motorsport cinema realism. Shot with a mix of POV cockpit footage, low chase tracking, dynamic overhead sweep and aggressive wheel-level close-ups. Bright mountain daylight, sharp alpine air, dust trails, flying gravel, strong sunlight, cinematic depth, no arcade-game look.

Central vehicle: one high-performance rally car, compact, aggressive stance, mud-splashed bodywork, racing livery without readable logos. Driver is visible only through POV hands gripping the steering wheel and brief windshield reflections.

Narrow mountain rally road cut into a steep rocky slope, deep precipice on one side, jagged cliff wall on the other, loose gravel, sharp bends, sparse alpine vegetation, distant peaks, unstable rock above the road.
Photorealistic rally physics, realistic suspension compression, coherent mountain-road geography, believable rockslide behavior, intense speed sensation, stable vehicle proportions, readable action, strong tire grip detail, premium dust and gravel effects.

0-5s: POV cockpit shot
first-person driver view from inside the rally car. Both gloved hands grip the steering wheel tightly while the car races at full speed along the narrow mountain road. The windshield reveals the cliff wall on one side and a terrifying precipice on the other. The steering shakes violently over gravel, sunlight flashes across the dashboard, and dust trails behind.

5-10s: Overhead sweep into side tracking
The car attacks a fast bend with the cliff wall on the left and the sheer drop on the right. Small rocks begin falling from above. The driver keeps full commitment as pebbles bounce across the road.

10-15s: Aggressive close-up sequence + speed ramp
A sudden rockslide crashes down ahead. Large stones slam onto the road, dust explodes into the air. The rally car snaps sideways into a controlled drift, threads through a narrow opening between boulders and the cliff edge, wheels skimming dangerously close to the precipice.

15-20s: Hero chase shot into wide reveal
The car bursts through the dust cloud, regains full traction and accelerates away at maximum speed. More debris crashes down behind it as it disappears into the next mountain turn, leaving a long plume of dust above the abyss.

#DreaminaCPP

@dreamina_ai

entries.title: WasifAI · Super Woman finally revealed her powers. Seedance 2.5 prompt: 30s | 16:9 | one continuous genera
entries.text:
Super Woman finally revealed her powers.

Seedance 2.5

prompt:
30s | 16:9 | one continuous generation | ultra-photorealistic live-action AAA martial-arts VFX

SO-YEON is the exact same real human throughout, 160cm small frame, messy black hair, black hoodie/sweats/Converse, natural pores/eyes/hair/biomechanics. Never CGI/digital double. Empty Korean high-school gym, late afternoon, sunbeams/dust, bleachers, scoreboard, basketballs, badminton rackets. 5 unarmed delinquent male classmates in dark untidy uniforms. Korean dialogue, no BGM/subtitles; only diegetic ambience, voices, impacts, static hiss.

00–03: So-Yeon cowers by bleachers, surrounded. Leader smacks her head: “어쭈? 이 년 봐라? 많이 컸다?” She glares coldly through bangs, then fear returns: “아…! 미안…”

03–06: He swings again.

06–09: 0.3s micro-slow-mo: awakened body autonomously slips fist → Silat parry → pivot → body punch. THUMP + sharp white-blue static flash. Hair rises, dust scatters. Snap back to real-time; leader crashes/slides away.

09–12: She stares at trembling hand, tiny static crawling between fingers, terrified/disbelieving. “저 년이?!” Four rush simultaneously.

12–17: Extreme physical dash: PARRY → wrist redirect → elbow → low sweep; side-kick second attacker. 0.2s impact slow-mo with branching static flash, hair/uniform fibers rising, papers/shuttlecocks scattering. Snap back; never stops.

17–22: Two attack together. Diagonal dash → duck hook → redirect momentum → high roundhouse. Static arc-flash at impact; hair stands up, shuttlecocks fly, scoreboard flickers.

22–27: Final attacker from behind. Maximum real-body acceleration; camera lags/overshoots, violent whip-pan reacquires. Evade → parry → redirect → jab → body punch → low kick → spinning Taekwondo back kick. 0.25s slow-mo: dense branching static at heel impact, uniform puffs, dust/paper pulled inward then blasted outward.

27–30: Violent physical discharge: KRA-KRACKLE! Static-white ring races across floor; dust/paper explode outward, fluorescent lights flicker, basketball rolls off cart. Enemy slides far away. Flash hits lens: flare/interference/dust, then rapid stabilization. So-Yeon lands, sees fading sparks on her hands, half fear/half wonder, exhales, straightens and walks calmly through dust, hair falling over eyes. Never looks back. CUT.

COMBAT: Awakened So-Yeon fights completely unarmed, calm/precise/extremely fast, fluid Taekwondo × Karate × Pencak Silat: punch → kick → evade → parry → redirect → dash → counter → sweep → palm/elbow → angle change. No reset poses; momentum continuously flows. Bullies attack simultaneously, never take turns.

STATIC BLOOM RULE: White-blue friction discharge ONLY. Real-time → physical dash burst → 0.15–0.35s impact slow-mo → snap back. Sparks crawl along skin/hair/hoodie; hair/threads lift; filaments jump between fingers/joints; dust follows slipstream. No teleportation, aura, projectile, beam, plasma, fireball, petals, or magic. Every discharge must originate from visible physical contact and extreme velocity. Impact → charge build → branching arc → dust/paper scatter. Static never causes the initial impact.

CAMERA: close, kinetic handheld pursuit, tracking, low angles, OTS/facial inserts, rapid focus shifts, whip-pans; follows but cannot perfectly anticipate acceleration. Shake only from real impacts/discharges. Action readability > chaos.
